steps.title: Compare methods rather than memorise labels
steps.intro: War, alliance and annexation could all extend Company power, but their mechanisms differed.
steps.simple: War, alliance and annexation could all extend Company power, but their mechanisms differed.
example: War, alliance and annexation could all extend Company power, but their mechanisms differed.

A Subsidiary Alliance constrained a ruler through troops, money and diplomatic restrictions; lapse converted a succession claim into annexation. War used armed force and settlements. Use a dated example for each, and distinguish the Company from later Crown rule.
